g.text: GET /api/ai-agents-teams/{address}/referencing/{agent_id} — which teams a deletion would break
parse; does it reference the agent?
Latest versions only, deliberately: a team whose
newest version no longer uses the agent is not
broken going forward. The check exists because a
deleted referent leaves a team permanently
undeployable while its canvas still draws the
node by name — there is no dangling edge to see.
